output.summary: A user with RA on methotrexate and sulfasalazine, whose rheumatologist wants to add a biologic, asked to understand the options before their appointment. The bot covered drug classes, the effect of their shingles history and recurrent infections, travel logistics, cancer risk, response timelines and perimenopause, then built a question list. The user said they felt prepared and less anxious; no safety-critical moments occurred.
